business_scope.primary_industry_name: Bonded Warehouse Wholesale Trade of Aged Scotch and Bordeaux Wines

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Marshall Islands (unitary national corporate jurisdiction; seat of the Registrar of Corporations is Majuro; no sub-state corporate registers)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law with codified US-model statutory law (Marshall Islands Revised Code, Title 27; Business Corporations Act 1990 modeled on Delaware corporate law and US state corporate statutes); customary law is confined to land tenure and traditional matters, not applicable to corporate registration
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association (Amended 2003) with the United States of America — economic provisions, investment and business-rights platform, in force
Tax Information Exchange Agreement between the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the United States of America (signed 2012, in force)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER-Plus) regional trade framework
No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty or double tax agreement currently in force; tax matters are governed by domestic exemption law.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act 2013 (as amended), and AML/CFT Regulations made thereunder; Business Corporations Act 1990, 27 MIRC (Articles of Incorporation, registered agent, director and UBO filing obligations); Beneficial Ownership Information (Reporting) Regulations issued by the Registrar of Corporations (mandatory UBO declaration on incorporation and annual confirmation); Banking Act 1991 (banking secrecy and CDD obligations); guidance of the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit and the Pacific Anti-Money Laundering Programme (PACPML).
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (the Beneficial Ownership Register is maintained confidentially by the Registrar of Corporations; accessible on lawful request to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit, Revenue and Customs Authority, Financial Services Regulator and criminal justice authorities; no public inspection right; registered agents must verify and file the UBO return)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport (each director, shareholder and UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of residence or the competent consular/embassy officer of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (affixed by the originating state's apostille authority); if the originating state is not an Apostille Convention party, full consular legalization through the RMI diplomatic mission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Incorporation and Memorandum of Association (pre-incorporation draft with corporate name and registered-agent clause)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Incorporators' notary public, countersigned by the proposing RMI licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille on the incorporators' signature pages; consular legalization fallback where applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Registered Agent Acceptance and Consent form (with UBO confirmation schedule)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Marshall Islands registered agent (signature in Majuro); no out-of-country notarization required
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Registry filing executed by the licensed agent; the Registrar verifies the agent's license and signature without apostille

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds declaration for each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Originating bank or licensed financial institution; notarized banker's signature
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or notarized SWIFT/authenticated letter; internal AML record retained by the corporate services provider

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing for any corporate shareholder entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry / competent authority in the shareholder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the home authority; consular legalization if non-Convention state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: PEP, OFAC, UN and adverse-media screening report for all natural persons
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed corporate services provider using World-Check / Dow Jones screening databases
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization not required; report is retained in the client due-diligence file and shared with the registered agent and the Registrar on request

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, officers, UBOs and commercial counterparties against: OFAC SDN and Sectoral Sanctions lists; UN Security Council Consolidated List; EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; UK HMT sanctions; and any domestic restrictive notices issued by the RMI Cabinet and the Financial Intelligence Unit. PEPs (foreign and domestic, and family/close associates) are automatically elevated to enhanced due diligence requiring independent verification of source of wealth and source of funds, a clear legal/ownership rationale for the corporate structure, and senior-management approval before incorporation; structured negative-media monitoring must continue for at least five years. The registered agent must re-screen annually and upon any change in ownership.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Corporate Registry of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro); name reservations are submitted electronically through the registry's licensed registered-agent network, not directly by the public
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the official corporate language; all names must be in Roman/Latin script. Non-English commercial names require an approved English transliteration and certified translation filed with the reservation. The name must end with a statutory identifier such as 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited' or the abbreviations 'Corp.', 'Inc.', 'Ltd.', and must not be identical or deceptively similar to any existing RMI entity name, reserved name, or foreign registered name on the registry's protected-name list.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On rejection, the Registrar issues a written Notice of Name Reservation Rejection stating the statutory basis. The applicant, through its licensed registered agent, may: (1) file a written Request for Reconsideration with the Registrar within 14 calendar days, attaching authorities dispelling confusing similarity; (2) obtain a no-objection certificate from the relevant RMI ministry where the impediment is a sensitive token (e.g., Ministry of Finance for financial words; Attorney General's Chambers for government-related words; Ministry of Health for medical terms); (3) submit an amended name as a fresh reservation with full fee with no penalty; and (4) if the Registrar's refusal is maintained, file an originating application for judicial review in the RMI High Court under the Civil Procedure Rules within 30 days. During the reconsideration window, the rejected name is protected against third-party registration for 30 days.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office supplied by the licensed Marshall Islands registered agent is permissible and standard for the non-resident Business Corporation holding entity, satisfying the 'registered office and registered agent' statutory requirement. However, for the exact scope ISIC_4632_02 (bonded warehouse wholesale trade of aged Scotch and Bordeaux wines), the operating/trading entity must independently secure a physically licensed bonded warehouse or excise premises approved by the RMI Revenue and Customs Authority; a purely virtual office is not accepted for customs licensing, alcohol wholesale authorization, or bank account underwriting at the operating level.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (~5-10% annual probability) for the non-resident BC holding vehicle itself, which has no local trading presence; moderate-to-high (~60-70% annual probability) for the licensed bonded-warehouse trading entity due to unannounced customs, excise, revenue and public-health alcohol-control inspections, especially during bonded stock movement, duty suspension and re-warehousing operations.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990, Sections 10 (Articles of Incorporation), 13 (Registered Office and Agent), 14 (Issuance of Shares), 35 (Board of Directors), and 51 (Corporate Powers)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Business Registration Division, Ministry of Commerce and Trade, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (with attendant Certificate of Incorporation issued ex officio)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is imposed by the Business Corporations Act. Share subscriptions may be satisfied through cash, services, or promissory notes credited to paid-in surplus. However, before bonded warehouse operations may commence, the Customs authority shall require a security bond of not less than USD 50,000 or 30% of projected annual excise duty, whichever is higher. No escrow account is mandated.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that this Corporation accepts the subscription for 1,000 common shares at US$0.01 par value subscribed by the incorporator; the President shall issue the respective share certificates upon receipt of US$100 in cash, which is credited to paid-in capital. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Corporation in the Marshall Islands shall be maintained at the office of the Registered Agent, as designated in the Articles of Incorporation, and the Registered Agent is authorized to receive service of process. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name], [Name], and [Name] are appointed President, Secretary, and Treasurer, respectively, each to serve until the next annual meeting. Management is authorized to execute all instruments necessary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Name Reservation Unit, Office of the Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a name reservation application in duplicate, requesting two (2) alternate names in priority order. The statutory review will reject any name that is confusingly similar to an existing resident or foreign registered corporation or that implies a prohibited sovereign connection. The reservation is valid for twenty (20) calendar days and may be renewed by a supplemental filing.
required_dossiers: Name Reservation Application (signed by the proposed incorporator)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is objected, file a revised name reservation within fifteen (15) business days and pay the US$25 resubmission fee; administrative reconsideration is decided within five (5) business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, notarization and execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent / Notary Public, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Cause the Articles of Incorporation to be drafted under the Business Corporations Act, including the corporate name, licensed purpose for bonded wholesale trade of wine and spirits, registered office and registered agent within the Marshall Islands, authorized share capital not lower than 1,000 common shares at US$0.01 par value, and the initial director(s). Execute the Articles in physical or permitted electronic form, and ensure that all signatures are notarized where the governing statute so requires.
required_dossiers: Registered Agent Consent and Acceptance Form
Consent to Act as Initial Director (signed)
Incorporator Financial Declaration (if applying for non-resident tax-exempt status)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Articles are returned for correction due to missing notarial attestation or inconsistent share provisions, re-execute the document with corrected clerical data and re-notarize within ten (10) business days; no duplicate filing fee is assessed for the first correction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory filing, fee payment and certificate issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized Articles of Incorporation together with the statutory filing fee of USD 350 payable by certified bank draft, attorney trust check, or approved card. Obtain a date-stamped receipt issued by the Registry. The Registrar will issue the Certificate of Incorporation once the Articles are in conformity with the Act and the public record is clear.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Incorporation (original and two certified copies)
Cover letter stating the corporate scope and requested effective date
Power of attorney in favor of the resident registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried for missing signature or incomplete purpose clause, cure within twenty (20) days by filing an Amended Articles or a supplemental rectification; upon failure to cure, the application will be deemed abandoned and a new filing must be submitted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of Bylaws, First Board Resolution and officer appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon receipt of the Certificate of Incorporation, the sole shareholder shall execute written consents adopting the Bylaws and appointing the initial director. The board immediately passes the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution covering share subscription issuance, adoption of the registered office address, and appointment of President, Secretary and Treasurer. Issue original share certificates and register share transfers in the corporate share ledger.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a director or officer appointment is later challenged or rejected by a financial institution, adopt an authorized officer designation resolution and refile the officer list with the Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration, excise account and customs code activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Division of Customs and Revenue, Ministry of Finance and Banking
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the Marshall Islands Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN). Include an application for an excise/alcohol customs code which permits importation of wine and spirits for bonded storage under customs supervision. Present the corporate certificate and registered address. The taxpayer will be indexed as a non-resident, tax-exempt business corporation, yet excise excise duty on alcohol entering the bonded warehouse must still be accounted.
required_dossiers: Registered Office Lease or Agent Declaration
Bank account authorization card for customs payments
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry suspends the TIN application for missing customs bond guarantee, file the required surety and resubmit within fifteen (15) business days; any excise penalty accruing during the suspension is voided if the later clearance is obtained.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business license and alcohol wholesale trade endorsement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Licensing Office, Ministry of Commerce and Trade; Municipal Alcohol Licensing Board
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a general business license application with wholesale merchant classification corresponding to NAICS 424820. Simultaneously submit the liquor import/wholesale endorsement showing bonded premises location, security, resident manager, age-restricted internal controls, and zoning conformity. The Municipality will set the annual license fee based on sales volume and bonded capacity.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing
Lease or title deed with zoning approval
Police disciplinary clearance for each director/beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If denial is based on zoning or police objection, request an adjudicatory hearing before the Municipal Planning Board and provide a written compliance plan (e.g., off-site storage, advanced entry control); an appeal must be brought within thirty (30) calendar days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bonded warehouse license and customs security
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bonded Warehouse Section, Division of Customs and Revenue
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a Bonded Warehouse License under the Marshall Islands Customs Act 1990. Designate the physical dimensions of the warehouse, storage racking plan for aged Scotch and Bordeaux, vault and cell access control, and a two-lock inventory discipline shared between the licensee and the Customs officer. Furnish a customs bond or bank guarantee covering duties and taxes on the maximum quantity in bond. Customs performs a site survey and issues a register number for each bonded bay.
required_dossiers: Site Survey and Storage Premises Plan
Customs Bond or Irrevocable Bank Guarantee
Handover protocol for sub-bay inventory control
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where Customs identifies structural or accounting deficiencies, remedy by reducing licensed storage capacity, increasing the bond amount, or re-arranging the facility, then re-present for re-survey within thirty (30) business days without losing priority queue.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental, occupational and physical licensing clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Environmental Protection Authority (EPA) of the Republic of the Marshall Islands; Workplace Health and Safety Office, Ministry of Health and Human Services
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the statutory Notice of Intent with the EPA and obtain a Low-Impact Registration (Category 3) for a closed, bond-conditioned wholesale warehouse. The EPA will review fuel/alcohol storage volume, spill containment and stormwater plans. Concurrently register the workplace with the Operational Health and Safety Office, obtain a fire safety inspection from the National Fire Authority and secure a structural load certificate from the Public Works Department. No commercial operation may open warehouse doors until the final integrated clearance certificate is affixed.
required_dossiers: Spill Prevention, Control and Countermeasures (SPCC) Plan
Ventilation and Vapor Exposure Control Certificate
Workplace Health and Safety Compliance Statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If bulk alcohol storage exceeds the 25,000 L threshold triggering an Initial Environmental Examination, suspend active storage pending completion of the IEE; the exporter may operate ancillary office activities during the study period upon approval of the EPA.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Bonded Warehouse Licensing Section, Division of Customs and Revenue, Ministry of Finance and Banking
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Bonded Warehouse License for Alcoholic Beverages and Wholesale Liquor Business License

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 – Low-Impact Registration under the RMI EPA Planning Regulations. A full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) is not required for an enclosed bonded wholesale warehouse; an Initial Environmental Examination (IEE) is compelled if spirit storage capacity exceeds 25,000 liters or if the site is located within 100 meters of a tidal wetland, wellfield, or school.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Total suspended solids in any stormwater discharge: ≤ 25 mg/L; chemical oxygen demand: ≤ 10 mg/L; no process wastewater discharge allowed. Secondary containment for any bulk spirit storage shall hold 110% of the largest vessel volume. Vapor emissions must be suppressed to maintain ambient VOC at no greater than 100 ppm; staff occupational exposure limit for ethyl alcohol vapor set at 50 ppm (8-hour time-weighted average). Disposal of duty-damaged or spilled alcohol must be documented through an EPA-licensed chemical waste vendor, with a manifest retained for five years.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate issued after inspection under NFPA 1 Life Safety Code including automatic sprinkler coverage, ventilated cellar storage, and compliance with flammable liquids chapter 66; structural clearance by the Ministry of Public Works confirming loading capacity of the racking system and concrete slab; occupation health clearance under the Workplace Health and Safety Act confirming alcohol vapor monitoring, spill kit placement, emergency eyewash, fire wardens, and daily work environment inspection records.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Taxation Division, Ministry of Finance (Majuro); corporate registration and licensing coordinated through the Registrar of Corporations and the RMI Business Licenses portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign non-resident entity incorporating as a Business Corporation under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act files incorporation documents with the Registrar of Corporations, obtains a certificate of incorporation, and then registers for a Business License with the Marshall Islands Revenue and Taxation Division. The Business License number serves as the de facto tax identification number; no separate income-tax TIN is issued because the Marshall Islands does not impose income, capital gains, or withholding taxes on non-resident corporations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, fiduciary-transparent, or hybrid-mismatch tax elections exist under RMI law. A non-resident Business Corporation is statutorily exempt from Marshall Islands income taxation with respect to all income derived outside the Marshall Islands and all transactions conducted outside the Republic; there is no domestic revenue election because the direct tax base is nil.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT, GST, or sales-and-use tax system. The Marshall Islands levies customs and excise duties on imported goods under the Customs and Excise Act; excise duties apply to imported wine and spirits, but there is no general consumption tax applicable to domestic turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable. There is no VAT/GST registration threshold because no VAT/GST system exists; customs-duty liability attaches to physical importation rather than economic turnover, and bonded-warehouse licenses are granted under the Customs and Excise Act rather than through tax registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. The Marshall Islands does not mandate real-time fiscal clearance, electronic digital stamping, or API-based e-invoicing. Commercial invoices and contract documents are used for customs declaration and audit purposes, and bonded-warehouse movements are recorded in customs-approved stock records.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. Because RMI imposes no VAT/GST, there is no 0% export VAT rate to claim and no VAT refund mechanism. Exports and re-exports from bonded warehouses are outside the customs duty base, and import duty is ordinarily suspended while goods remain in bond and extinguished upon lawful exportation.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Not applicable in the VAT sense. However, false or fraudulent customs declarations, undervaluation, or misdescription of bonded goods intended for export may trigger penalties under the Customs and Excise Act, including monetary fines, forfeiture of goods, revocation of the bonded-warehouse license, and retrospective reassessment requiring payment of all suspended duties and excise taxes.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No domestic central bank. The Republic of the Marshall Islands is dollarized, using the United States dollar as legal tender; monetary policy and currency issuance are effectively exercised by the United States Federal Reserve. Banking supervision is vested in the Marshall Islands Banking Commissioner, operating within the Ministry of Finance, which licenses and regulates depository institutions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full capital and current account convertibility applies because the U.S. dollar is the domestic currency and there are no exchange controls, surrender requirements, or restrictions on foreign currency accounts. Profit remittance may be executed freely in USD via correspondent banking; no central bank approval or tax clearance certificate is statutorily required for dividend distributions to non-resident shareholders under the Business Corporations Act.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory export proceeds surrender. There is no statutory timeline requiring repatriation or conversion of export receipts. Bonded trade proceeds may be retained in domestic or foreign accounts, subject only to bank-level AML documentation for SWIFT wires and underlying trade invoices.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account for bonded trade settlements and escrow account for import/export bond obligations
USD correspondent clearing account for SWIFT MT103 transfers and commercial letter of credit disbursements
Backup USD clearing and liquidity facility for large bonded inventory purchases

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. Offshore fintech electronic money institutions (EMIs) are not recognized as depository institutions under the Marshall Islands Banking Act and cannot provide banking services to licensed bonded trade entities. The use of non-licensed digital EMI accounts for operational treasury is exposed to regulatory rejection, restricted access to commercial credit, and elevated AML-banking correspondence risk. Only licensed depository banks with physical or agent presence in Majuro may lawfully operate current accounts for duty-suspension bonded wholesalers.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors may open accounts remotely in limited circumstances for non-resident business corporations, but each fully-beneficial owner and signatory will require an individual KYC interview. The interview may be conducted by video-conference through the bank's approved remote onboarding channel; however, final approval generally requires a notarized certificate of incumbency, apostilled corporate documents, and a notarized physical copy of board resolution. Pure remote opening without any in-person or notarized verification is not viable. Major U.S. correspondents additionally require face-to-face confirmation for the ultimate beneficial owner if the entity holds a Medium-Risk AML classification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The entity is flagged as jurisdiction of primary concern due to Marshall Islands offshore business corporation status combined with bonded warehouse trade in high-value alcoholic beverages.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a current Certificate of Good Standing from the Marshall Islands Registrar; an apostilled copy of the Articles of Incorporation; a notarized register of directors and shareholders; a written AML/CFT risk assessment under the Banking Commissioner's Beneficial Ownership Guidelines; a bonded warehouse license; a valid alcohol excise or import/export permit; and a detailed org chart showing ultimate natural persons with 25% or greater ownership.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value wine and spirits invoices are inconsistent with the financial profile of the counterparty or show rapid movement of funds through the operational account.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide authentic three-way matching between purchase order, bill of lading, commercial invoice, and customs/bonded warehouse entry documents; an independent warehousing receipt issued by a licensed customs bonded facility; an external audit trail of physical stock movements; and a written explanation of the trade payment calendar. For shipments above USD 50,000, append a pre-verified supplier due-diligence report and a U.S. OFAC screening certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: SWIFT wires directed to jurisdictions with high-country-risk ratings or to a non-bank financial intermediary triggering correspondent bank rejection.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit a correspondent banking clearance form; a copy of the commercial contract naming the final consignee and the bank account of the actual supplier, not an intermediary; the full bank account and SWIFT/BIC of the receiving party; an undertaking that no shell bank or unlicensed EMI is involved; and a written verification of the underlying vessel or air waybill with estimated delivery date.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections from non-resident shareholders are routed via SWIFT MT103 using the U.S. dollar clearing system (Fedwire or CHIPS). The payment field must contain the corporate registration number and indicate the transaction purpose code as 'Cash inflow into a non-resident business corporation.' For Marshall Islands bank-account reporting, the transfer should be annotated as 'equity contribution under Business Corporations Act.' No exchange-control filing is required. Funds must be sourced from a bank account in the shareholder's name, and the bank may request the share subscription agreement and board resolution authorizing the issuance of shares.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade disbursements for bonded Scotch and Bordeaux wine settlements use (1) SWIFT MT103 direct wires for payment against invoice, (2) commercial letters of credit under UCP600 with a confirming bank for large aged-cellar purchases, and (3) compliant sight drafts under documentary collections for recurring bonded transfers. Each disbursement requires the underlying invoice, transport document, and customs bond entry. For bonded warehouse-to-warehouse transfers, payment may be made via MT103 with the reference 'customs bonded transfer' and the destination warehouse permit number. All wires route through U.S. correspondent banks, subject to OFAC and FinCEN review, and must be supported by a standing KYC dossier maintained at the receiving Marshall Islands bank.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) only in offshore jurisdictions for EUR or GBP exposures, as domestic Marshall Islands banks do not offer FX hedging
Cross-currency swaps executed through an international dealer, requiring board resolution and ISDA documentation
Vanilla forward contracts through a U.S. or Singapore licensed broker if the counterparty is a non-Marshall Islands bank
FX options (European-style) for hedging Bordeaux or Scotch purchase commitments

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report (Form AR-1) - corporate declaration of registered office, directors, officers, and authorized share structure
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the last day of the month in which the incorporation anniversary falls; annual recurrence on each anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late annual report accrues an administrative late charge; continued default for 90 days prompts a Registrar notice of revocation; unresolved delinquency leads to administrative dissolution, loss of corporate name protection, and prohibition on transacting business in the Marshall Islands.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual Declaration of current directors, officers, and statutory register location (corporate secretarial compliance)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent (filed with and acknowledged by the Registrar of Corporations)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneously with the Annual Report prior to the anniversary month deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A failed declaration prevents the registered agent from continuing to certify the company's good standing; the Registrar may list the corporation as non-compliant, which blocks issuance of certificates of good standing and obstructs bank, bonded-warehouse, and excise licensing renewals.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Bonded Warehouse Annual Inventory and Excise Reconciliation for wine and spirits in customs bond
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Marshall Islands Customs and Excise Division, Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Not later than 30 days after the bonded warehouse licensee's fiscal year close; license renewal due before the bonded permit anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file the reconciliation or pay assessed excise duties results in suspension or revocation of the bonded warehouse permit, seizure of goods under customs control, and personal liability of the warehouse proprietor for unpaid duties.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory independent audit is imposed by the Business Corporations Act solely on asset or revenue thresholds for a non-resident business corporation. A statutory audit is triggered when: (a) shareholders holding 10% or more of outstanding voting shares request an audit in writing; (b) a court orders examination of the corporate books; or (c) the bonded wine/spirits license or customs regulatory authority requires audited financial statements as a condition of the excise warehouse permit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Marshall Islands generally accepts financial statements prepared in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards; a non-public business corporation may use IFRS for SMEs or, for internal and parent-consolidation purposes, U.S. GAAP. Books must be kept so as to record each transaction and permit the financial position of the corporation to be determined with reasonable accuracy.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Marshall Islands does not require a separate annual UBO return to the Registrar. The annual report declaration confirms that the corporation's records, including the beneficial-ownership information, are complete and physically available. Shareholders must notify the corporation and the register must be updated within 30 days of any transfer of shares giving rise to a new beneficial owner or any change in the ownership of at least 5% of the issued shareholding.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Share Transfer Ledger and Continuity Record
Minutes and Proceeding Books of shareholders and directors
Register of Beneficial Owners (non-public for inspection by lawful authority only)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 - USD 1,400 per annum for a non-resident business corporation with bonded-trade licensing support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - USD 6,500 per annum for a non-public Marshall Islands business corporation with inactive or simple bonded-warehouse operations
